long_biography.plain_text:
Dmitri Bukhman was born in Vologda, Russia, in 1985. He began selling PC games online with his older brother Igor while still in high school, then co-founded Playrix in 2004 while studying programming. The brothers shifted from downloadable PC titles to mobile gaming, building successes including Homescapes and Fishdom while retaining majority ownership and avoiding outside funding.

Playrix remains the foundation of Bukhman's wealth, which Forbes classifies as self-made and derived from online games. The brothers later created Rix Capital to manage their investment and philanthropic activities through a diversified portfolio with a substantial global venture-capital allocation. Dmitri and his wife Daria also founded Bukhman Philanthropies, focusing on maternal and neonatal support, young people's mental health and wellbeing, and literature.
